defects.title: from-order endpoint accepts Draft/PendingConfirmation orders — only Cancelled tested; PO decision needed
defects.invariant: Bill creation from order must align with business rule for 'gönderilmiş sipariş' — if only Confirmed/Accepted orders should create bills, Draft/Submitted/PendingConfirmation must be rejected
defects.mechanism: BillingSplitStore.cs:427-428 rejects only OrderState.Cancelled or OrderState.Rejected. OrderState.Draft, OrderState.Submitted, OrderState.PendingConfirmation all pass through and create bills. BillingSplitHttpTests.cs:211-220 tests only Cancelled order rejection (line 226-227). PO decision not documented in task markdown. Identity with F0903 not established (1020 main record).
defects.acceptance: PO decision required: (a) confirm current behavior is correct and update task markdown to document accepted states, or (b) reject Draft/Submitted/PendingConfirmation in CreateBillFromOrderAsync and add tests. If (b), new task needed for implementation.

limitations: Read-only review; PO decision required to resolve. This is a business rule question, not a code defect per se. Duplicate candidate with F0903 — same underlying code behavior but different classification (PO question vs. defect candidate).
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
